Adyen — payments

adyen/payments · version 1

envs add adyen/payments

This declares the keys below in your catalog and sets none of them. A template is a schema for keys; it never carries a value.

Key Needed Kind Notes
ADYEN_API_KEY required secret Adyen says API keys must be protected, rotated, and not exposed in client-side code. Generating a new one activates it immediately and leaves the previous key working for twenty-four hours, which is the overlap to move over in. The name is convention.. where to get it
ADYEN_CLIENT_KEY required config Adyen says the client key is not used for API requests and exists so Drop-in and Components can collect card details in the browser. Only the environment prefix is documented, so the pattern checks that and nothing more. The name is convention.. Shape ^(test|live)_.+$. where to get it
